about: The request GroqSTT sends for one fixed clip: plan 002, Block 0, step 11. Track B's tests
compare the request its fake transport receives with this, field by field. Its sources:
2026-11-01), Groq's speech-to-text reference (read 2026-11-01, plan 002), and the
installed groq 1.7.0 (groq/resources/audio/transcriptions.py, lines 236 and 454: the path;
groq/_qs.py, lines 120-128: a form value is str(value), so temperature 0 is sent as 0).
The prototype sent no media type, so httpx guessed one from the file name, which differs
between machines (audio/wav on the owner's, audio/x-wav from Python's own table); here it

clip.wav: mono, 16-bit, 16000 Hz, written with the standard library's wave
